hypothesis: The same Coulomb source pair multiplies the same target radial spinor repeatedly; exact per-evaluation action reuse can eliminate those repeated matrix-vector products without altering the signed CI gradient.

fixed_model.coefficients: nuclear positive-energy Dirac eigenfunctions, metric-orthonormal in each kappa
fixed_model.Hamiltonian: native same-cell Dirac-Coulomb, shared signed angular CI weights
fixed_model.scope: real finite-model MCDHF orbital gradient kernel; neither full Yb calculation nor end-to-end speedup

resource_preflight.action_cache_scope: discard after each source pair, exact orbital keys from immutable evaluation argument

stopping: Stop and retain failure if any gradient or independent directional derivative gate fails; do not alter tolerances or representation. A failed load guard permits correctness and observed timings but forbids controlled speedup claims.
